HoggerBonestoGnaw.name: Bones to Gnaw

HoggerOnTheProwl.description: Activate to gain 30 Rage over 8 seconds.  Passive: You heal for 8 (+4% per level) Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

HoggerShockwave.name: Shockwave
HoggerShockwave.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. HoggerDustDevil.name: Dust Devil

HoggerPowerSpike.name: Power Spike

HoggerNoControl.name: No Control
HoggerNoControl.description: Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.  Cannot be cancelled.

ChoCthunsGiftTalent.name: C'Thun's Gift

ChoFavorOfTheOldGods.name: Favor of the Old Gods

ChoFavorOfTheOldGodsTalent.name: Favor of the Old Gods
ChoFavorOfTheOldGodsTalent.description: Upheaval Roots enemy Heroes for 2 seconds.

ChoFuelForTheFlame.name: Fuel for the Flame
ChoFuelForTheFlame.description: Basic Attacks against enemies cause them to explode, dealing 21 (+4% per level) damage to them and 45 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  This damage is doubled against enemy Heroes.

ChoFuelForTheFlameTalent.name: Fuel for the Flame
ChoFuelForTheFlameTalent.description: Basic Attacks against enemies cause them to explode, dealing 21 (+4% per level) damage to them and 45 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  This damage is doubled against enemy Heroes.

RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasSulfurasHungers.name: Sulfuras Hungers
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasSulfurasHungers.description: Quest: Every time Empower Sulfuras kills a Minion, its damage is increased by 1, up to 25.  Reward: After killing 25 Minions, increase its damage by an additional 100.

RagnarosLivingMeteorShiftingMeteor.name: Shifting Meteor
RagnarosLivingMeteorShiftingMeteor.description: Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it.  Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor.  Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction once per use.

RagnarosBlastWaveEngulfingFlame.name: Engulfing Flame
RagnarosBlastWaveEngulfingFlame.description: Increase Blast Wave's damage by 75% and its radius by 15%.

RagnarosLivingMeteorFireWard.name: Fire Ward
RagnarosLivingMeteorFireWard.description: When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

RagnarosBlastWaveSlowBurn.name: Slow Burn
RagnarosBlastWaveSlowBurn.description: Blast Wave slows enemies hit by 40% for 2 seconds.

RagnarosCatchingFire.name: Catching Fire
RagnarosCatchingFire.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75.  Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

RagnarosCatchingFireTalent.name: Catching Fire
RagnarosCatchingFireTalent.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75.  Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasHandOfRagnaros.name: Hand of Ragnaros
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasHandOfRagnaros.description: If Empower Sulfuras hits at least 2 enemy Heroes, refund 10 Mana and its cooldown recharges 100% faster for 4 seconds.

RagnarosLivingMeteorMoltenPower.name: Molten Power
RagnarosLivingMeteorMoltenPower.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

RagnarosBlisteringAttacks.name: Blistering Attacks
RagnarosBlisteringAttacks.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

RagnarosSulfurasSmash.name: Sulfuras Smash
RagnarosSulfurasSmash.description: Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.

RagnarosLavaWave.name: Lava Wave
RagnarosLavaWave.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

RagnarosLavaWaveTargetPoint.name: Lava Wave
RagnarosLavaWaveTargetPoint.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasCauterizeWounds.name: Cauterize Wounds
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasCauterizeWounds.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

RagnarosBlastWaveTemperedFlame.name: Tempered Flame
RagnarosBlastWaveTemperedFlame.description: When Blast Wave damages an enemy Hero, gain a Shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds.

RagnarosResilientFlame.name: Resilient Flame
RagnarosResilientFlame.description: When Ragnaros is Stunned, he gains 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%.  This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasGiantScorcher.name: Giant Scorcher
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasGiantScorcher.description: Empower Sulfuras burns enemy Heroes for 9% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds. This additional damage does not heal Ragnaros.

RagnarosLivingMeteorMeteorBomb.name: Meteor Bomb
RagnarosLivingMeteorMeteorBomb.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

RagnarosBlastWaveBlastEcho.name: Blast Echo
RagnarosBlastWaveBlastEcho.description: After Blast Wave explodes, another Blast Wave is created on Ragnaros.

RagnarosSulfurasSmashFlamesOfSulfuron.name: Flames of Sulfuron
RagnarosSulfurasSmashFlamesOfSulfuron.description: Sulfuras Smash Slows enemies by 50% for 2.5 seconds, and the Stun duration of enemies hit in the center is increased by 1 second.

RagnarosLavaWaveLavaSurge.name: Lava Surge
RagnarosLavaWaveLavaSurge.description: Lava Wave gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds.

RagnarosMoltenCoreHeroicDifficulty.name: Heroic Difficulty
RagnarosMoltenCoreHeroicDifficulty.description: Molten Core has 25% increased Health and Damage, and its cooldown is reduced by 50 seconds.

RagnarosSubmerge.name: Submerge
RagnarosSubmerge.description: Ragnaros submerges below, entering Stasis and healing for 600 (+4% per level) Health over 3 seconds.

AzmodanGreed.name: Greed
AzmodanGreed.description: Globe of Annihilation deals 15% more damage to non-Heroic targets.  Quest: After gaining 200 Annihilation, increase the range of All Shall Burn by 25% and Demon Warriors gain 20% Attack Speed and Movement Speed.

AzmodanGluttony.name: Gluttony
AzmodanGluttony.description: Increase the number of stacks of Annihilation gained by hitting Heroes with Globe of Annihilation from 2 to 4.  Quest: After gaining 200 Annihilation, each enemy hit by Globe of Annihilation reduces its cooldown by 0.25 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

AzmodanWrath.name: Wrath
AzmodanWrath.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes under 75% Health grant 1 Annihilation.  Quest: After gaining 200 Annihilation, hitting a Hero with Globe of Annihilation increases the damage of Azmodan's next Basic Attack against them within 3 seconds by 85% the amount of Annihilation he has.

AzmodanArmyOfHell.name: Army of Hell
AzmodanArmyOfHell.description: Summon Demon Warrior spawns an additional Demon, but its cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.

AzmodanHellforgedArmor.name: Hellforged Armor
AzmodanHellforgedArmor.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 20 Armor and last 4 seconds longer.

AzmodanSummonDemonWarriorHellforgedArmor.name: Hellforged Armor
AzmodanSummonDemonWarriorHellforgedArmor.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 20 Armor and last 4 seconds longer.

AzmodanBattleborn.name: Battleborn
AzmodanBattleborn.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Summon Demon Warrior from 25 to 20.  Azmodan's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Summon Demon Warrior by 0.75 seconds and Demon Lieutenant by 1.5 seconds.

AzmodanGlobOfAnnihilationBattlebornTalen.name: Battleborn
AzmodanGlobOfAnnihilationBattlebornTalen.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Summon Demon Warrior from 25 to 20.  Azmodan's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Summon Demon Warrior by 0.75 seconds and Demon Lieutenant by 1.5 seconds.

AzmodanArtOfChaos.name: Art of Chaos
AzmodanArtOfChaos.description: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 4 Annihilation.

AzmodanBombardment.name: Bombardment
AzmodanBombardment.description: After casting Globe of Annihilation, Azmodan's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds have an additional 1.5 range and can hit 3 additional targets. Hitting Heroes with Basic Attacks empowered by Bombardment grant 1 Annihilation.

AzmodanMasterofDestruction.name: Master of Destruction
AzmodanMasterofDestruction.description: If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration, All Shall Burn's final damage applies to all enemies in an area around the target and grants 2 Annihilation per Hero hit.

AzmodanAllShallBurnMasterOfDestructionTa.name: Master of Destruction
AzmodanAllShallBurnMasterOfDestructionTa.description: If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration, All Shall Burn's final damage applies to all enemies in an area around the target and grants 2 Annihilation per Hero hit.

AzmodanHeroicAbilityDemonicInvasion.name: Demonic Invasion
AzmodanHeroicAbilityDemonicInvasion.description: Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 39 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 10 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

AzmodanDemonicInvasion.name: Demonic Invasion
AzmodanDemonicInvasion.description: Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 39 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 10 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

AzmodanTideOfSin.name: Tide of Sin
AzmodanTideOfSin.description: Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

AzmodanBrutishVanguard.name: Brutish Vanguard
AzmodanBrutishVanguard.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 25% increased Health. Demon Warriors Slow nearby enemies by 20%.

AzmodanCydaeasKiss.name: Cydaea's Kiss
AzmodanCydaeasKiss.description: Reduces the Channel time of All Shall Burn by 0.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, Azmodan is healed for 8% of his maximum Health.

AzmodanChainOfCommand.name: Chain of Command
AzmodanChainOfCommand.description: The cooldown of Demon Lieutenants' Demonic Smite is reduced by 2 seconds and they grant 25% increased damage to nearby friendly Minions, Mercenaries, and Azmodan's summoned Demons.

AzmodanTotalAnnihilation.name: Total Annihilation
AzmodanTotalAnnihilation.description: Globe of Annihilation damages Heroes for an additional 4% of their maximum Health.

AzmodanHellRift.name: Hell Rift
AzmodanHellRift.description: If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills the target, a Demon Warrior is summoned at the target's location and all Demon Warriors deal 75% increased damage for 5 seconds.

AzmodanTrample.name: Trample
AzmodanTrample.description: Activate to charge a short distance, dealing 275 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies caught in the path by 60% for 1.25 second.

AzmodanSiegebreaker.name: Siegebreaker
AzmodanSiegebreaker.description: Azmodan's Demons deal 40% increased damage to Structures.

AzmodanBlackPool.name: Black Pool
AzmodanBlackPool.description: Globes of Annihilation empowered by Tide of Sin also leave a Black Pool at their impact location for 5 seconds. Enemies within the pool lose 8 Armor per second, up to 15, and take 56 (+4% per level) damage per second.

AzmodanTideOfSinBlackPoolTalent.name: Black Pool
AzmodanTideOfSinBlackPoolTalent.description: Globes of Annihilation empowered by Tide of Sin also leave a Black Pool at their impact location for 5 seconds. Enemies within the pool lose 8 Armor per second, up to 15, and take 56 (+4% per level) damage per second.

AzmodanPride.name: Pride
AzmodanPride.description: After gaining 400 Annihilation, the area of Globe of Annihilation is increased by 15% and it deals 125 additional damage.

AzmodanSinsGrasp.name: Sin's Grasp
AzmodanSinsGrasp.description: All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes by 15% during its Channel. If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills an enemy Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 50%, and the target is Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds.

AzmodanSinsGraspHotbar.name: Sin's Grasp
AzmodanSinsGraspHotbar.description: All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes by 15% during its Channel. If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills an enemy Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 50%, and the target is Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds.

DeathwingDragonSoul.name: Dragon Soul
DeathwingDragonSoul.description: Destroyer: Incinerate heals Deathwing for 75% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.  World Breaker: Lava Burst's explosion damage heals Deathwing for 150% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.

DeathwingMoltenBlood.name: Molten Blood
DeathwingMoltenBlood.description: While Deathwing has 3 or more Armor Plates, he heals for 0.6% of his maximum Health per second.

DeathwingDraconicMight.name: Draconic Might
DeathwingDraconicMight.description: Deathwing's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal him for 25% of the damage dealt. Upon losing an Armor Plate, Deathwing becomes Protected for 0.75 seconds.

DeathwingInfernus.name: Infernus
DeathwingInfernus.description: Increase the damage of Molten Flame against enemy Heroes by 25%.  Increase this damage bonus to 75% when Molten Flame is cast at 75 Energy or higher.

DeathwingHeatWave.name: Heat Wave
DeathwingHeatWave.description: Destroyer: After hitting an enemy Hero with Incinerate, Deathwing deals 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to all nearby enemies for the next 8 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.  World Breaker: Increase the explosion damage of Lava Burst by 125%.

DeathwingDragonsIre.name: Dragon's Ire
DeathwingDragonsIre.description: While Deathwing has 3 or fewer Armor Plates, his damage is increased by 25%.

DeathwingFirestorm.name: Firestorm
DeathwingFirestorm.description: Reduce the cooldown of Deathwing's landing Abilities by 2 seconds.  When Deathwing lands, he drops 7 meteors near the landing area, dealing 70 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Heroes hit by the meteors reduce Dragonflight's cooldown by 25 seconds.  Meteors prioritize landing on Heroes, otherwise they fall randomly in the area.

DeathwingDeathDrop.name: Death Drop
DeathwingDeathDrop.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Destroyer or World Breaker's landing damage reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 6 seconds and Deathwing's Basic Ability cooldowns by 2 seconds.

DeathwingSkyfall.name: Skyfall
DeathwingSkyfall.description: After using Dragonflight, Deathwing can drop meteors anywhere within vision dealing 58 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area. Has 3 charges.  If a Hero is hit, Deathwing heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

DeathwingBurnBeneathMyShadow.name: Burn Beneath My Shadow
DeathwingBurnBeneathMyShadow.description: When an enemy Fort or Keep is destroyed the cooldown of Cataclysm is reset. Cataclysm's periodic damage is increased by 80%.

DeathwingBellowingRoar.name: Bellowing Roar
DeathwingBellowingRoar.description: After 1 second, Deathwing unleashes a mighty roar, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and causing them to run in Fear for 1.5 seconds.

DeathwingBellowingRoarTalent.name: Bellowing Roar
DeathwingBellowingRoarTalent.description: After 1 second, Deathwing unleashes a mighty roar, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and causing them to run in Fear for 1.5 seconds.

DeathwingWickedInferno.name: Wicked Inferno
DeathwingWickedInferno.description: Molten Flame's Energy cost per second is reduced by 10.  After using Molten Flame, Deathwing gains 15 Energy over 3 seconds.

DeathwingRuination.name: Ruination
DeathwingRuination.description: Destroyer: The bite from Onslaught now Slows by 60% for 1.5 seconds.  World Breaker: Reduce Earth Shatter's cooldown by 6 seconds and its Energy cost by 10.

DeathwingFireAndFury.name: Fire and Fury
DeathwingFireAndFury.description: Basic Attacks against Rooted, Slowed, or Stunned enemy Heroes deal 30% additional damage and reduce the cooldowns of Deathwing's Basic Abilities by 0.5 seconds.

DeathwingConflagration.name: Conflagration
DeathwingConflagration.description: Dealing 320 (+4% per level) damage with Molten Flame to enemy Heroes within 4 seconds causes them to burn for an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. While burning, they explode every 1 second, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

DeathwingGazeOntoDestruction.name: Gaze Onto Destruction
DeathwingGazeOntoDestruction.description: Hitting Heroes with Destroyer or World Breaker's landing causes their damage to be reduced by 75% and Slows them by 40% for 5 seconds.

DeathwingElementiumPlating.name: Elementium Plating
DeathwingElementiumPlating.description: Activate to gain a Shield equal to 30% of Deathwing's missing Health for 8 seconds. While the Shield holds, Deathwing regenerates 2% of his maximum Health per second.  When the Shield expires or is destroyed, Deathwing regains Armor Plates appropriate for his new Health.  The Shield and effect end immediately if Deathwing uses Dragonflight.

DeathwingElementiumPlatingTalent.name: Elementium Plating

While the Shield holds, Deathwing regenerates 2% of his maximum Health per second.  When the Shield expires or is destroyed, Deathwing regains Armor Plates appropriate for his new Health.  The Shield and effect end immediately if Deathwing uses Dragonflight.

DeathwingStoodInTheFire.name: Stood in the Fire
DeathwingStoodInTheFire.description: Enemy Heroes are Slowed by 40% while standing in scorched ground, and its duration is increased by 50%.

DeathwingArrivalOfAGod.name: Arrival of a God
DeathwingArrivalOfAGod.description: Destroyer or World Breaker's landing damage is increased by 400%.  Deathwing also gains the benefits of all of his level 7 talents.

DeathwingDestroyersRampage.name: Destroyer's Rampage
DeathwingDestroyersRampage.description: For the next 6 seconds after landing in Destroyer form, Deathwing's damage is increased by 40% and his Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster.  Damaging Heroes refreshes this effect and switching to World Breaker form removes the effect.

Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lucio's maximum Mana by 10.  Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's range by 20%.

LucioSoundwaveSubwoofer.name: Subwoofer

LucioCrossfadeAllTogetherTalent.name: All Together

LucioSoundBarrierBossaNova.name: Bossa Nova

LucioCrossfadeMixingFire.name: Mixing Fire
LucioCrossfadeMixingFire.description: High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cost and cooldown of High Five by 30%.
